response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) as event_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(event_avg) as overall_avg FROM event_averages), filtered_events AS (SELECT ea.link_to_event, ea.event_avg, oa.overall_avg FROM event_averages ea CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE ea.event_avg > oa.overall_avg), kept_events_average AS (SELECT AVG(event_avg) as kept_avg FROM filtered_events), final_results AS (SELECT fe.link_to_event, fe.event_avg, fe.event_avg - fe.overall_avg as above_overall, fe.event_avg - kea.kept_avg as above_kept FROM filtered_events fe CROSS JOIN kept_events_average kea) SELECT link_to_event, event_avg, above_overall, above_kept FROM final_results ORDER BY above_kept DESC LIMIT 10
